cards.ex: We should dress up for the party tonight; it's a fancy event.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun kechqurun ziyofatga chiroyli kiyinishimiz kerak; bu hashamatli tadbir.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli va rasmiy kiyimlar kiyish, bayramga tayyorlanish.

cards.ex: It's Friday, so we can dress down at the office today.
cards.exUz: Bugun juma, shuning uchun biz bugun ofisda oddiy kiyinishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy va norasmiy kiyimlar kiyish, dam olish holati.

cards.ex: She's always fashion-forward, wearing the latest designs.
cards.exUz: U har doim moda ilg'ori, eng so'nggi dizaynlarni kiyadi.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi moda trendlarini kiyadigan, modada zamonaviy.

cards.ex: Not everyone can pull off that bold outfit, but she does!
cards.exUz: Hamma ham bu jasur libosni eplay olmaydi, lekin u eplaydi!
cards.uzDef: G'ayrioddiy kiyimni yaxshi ko'rinish bilan kiymoq, muvaffaqiyatli qilib ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: That style is a bit old-fashioned now, isn't it?
cards.exUz: Bu uslub hozir biroz eski moda, shunday emasmi?
cards.uzDef: Eski moda, zamonaviy bo'lmagan, urfdan qolgan.

cards.ex: That necklace is a real statement piece; it's so eye-catching.
cards.exUz: Bu marjon haqiqiy diqqatga sazovor narsa; u juda ko'zni qamashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimning asosiy va diqqatni tortuvchi qismi.

cards.ex: I like to mix and match different patterns and colors.
cards.exUz: Men turli xil naqsh va ranglarni aralashtirib moslashni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil kiyimlarni birga kiymoq, moslashtirmoq.

cards.ex: What's the dress code for the event? Is it formal?
cards.exUz: Tadbir uchun kiyim kodi qanday? U rasmiymi?
cards.uzDef: Qanday kiyinish kerakligi haqidagi qoidalar to'plami.

cards.ex: She buys anything that's trendy, she's a total fashion victim.
cards.exUz: U moda bo'lgan har qanday narsani sotib oladi, u butunlay moda qurboni.
cards.uzDef: Modani ko'r-ko'rona taqlid qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: That color is really on trend this season.
cards.exUz: Bu rang bu mavsumda haqiqatan ham modada.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi moda tendensiyalariga mos.

cards.ex: I just bought this dress off the rack; it was on sale.
cards.exUz: Men bu ko'ylakni do'kondan sotib oldim; u chegirmada edi.
cards.uzDef: Do'kondan sotib olingan, o'lchamga moslanmagan kiyim.

cards.ex: I used to wear my older brother's hand-me-downs.
cards.exUz: Men oldin akamning meros kiyimlarini kiyardim.
cards.uzDef: Oldin ishlatilgan va boshqa odamga berilgan kiyimlar.

cards.ex: She has an eye for fashion; she always looks great.
cards.exUz: U modani did bilan sezadi; u har doim ajoyib ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Go'zal va mos narsalarni tanlash qobiliyatiga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Don't forget to accessorize your outfit with a scarf and jewelry.
cards.exUz: Kiyimingizni ro'mol va zargarlik buyumlari bilan aksessuarlashni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimga aksessuarlar qo'shmoq, bezatmoq.

cards.ex: A classic black dress is a wardrobe staple.
cards.exUz: Klassik qora ko'ylak - bu asosiy kiyim.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kiyim shkafida bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan muhim kiyim.

cards.ex: I need to try on these jeans before I buy them.
cards.exUz: Men bu jinsilarni sotib olishdan oldin kiyib ko'rishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimni sotib olishdan oldin tanada ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: His suit is tailor-made; it fits him perfectly.
cards.exUz: Uning kostyumi tikilgan; u unga juda mos keladi.
cards.uzDef: Buyurtma asosida tikilgan, individual o'lchamlarga moslangan.

cards.ex: She is considered a fashion icon because of her unique style.
cards.exUz: U o'ziga xos uslubi tufayli moda ikoni hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Moda sohasida mashhur va ta'sirli shaxs.

cards.ex: This shirt is made of a soft, comfortable fabric.
cards.exUz: Bu ko'ylak yumshoq va qulay matodan qilingan.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimlar tikish uchun ishlatiladigan material.

cards.ex: This dress fits like a glove; it's perfect!
cards.exUz: Bu ko'ylak qo'lqopdek yarashadi; u juda zo'r!
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi mos kelmoq, aynan o'lchamda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: That scarf will go well with your coat.
cards.exUz: Bu ro'mol sizning paltoingizga yaxshi mos keladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan yaxshi ko'rinmoq, mos kelmoq.

cards.ex: She always goes for a classic look; it's timeless.
cards.exUz: U har doim klassik ko'rinishni tanlaydi; u abadiy.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon modadan qolmaydigan uslub.

cards.ex: She always stands out in a crowd because of her style.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z uslubi tufayli olomonda ajralib turadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farqli bo'lmoq, diqqatni tortmoq.

cards.ex: These shoes are all the rage this season.
cards.exUz: Bu poyabzallar bu mavsumda eng urfdagi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda juda mashhur va moda bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm going to dress to impress at the job interview.
cards.exUz: Men ish intervyusida taassurot qoldirish uchun kiyinmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga yaxshi taassurot qoldirish uchun yaxshi kiyinmoq.

cards.ex: Add a pop of color with a bright scarf or handbag.
cards.exUz: Yorqin ro'mol yoki sumka bilan rangli aksent qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Rangli kiyim yoki aksessuar, umumiy ko'rinishni jonlantirish uchun.

cards.ex: He is always well-dressed; he has great style.
cards.exUz: U har doim yaxshi kiyingan; u ajoyib uslubga ega.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli va zamonaviy kiyingan odam.

cards.ex: Her bold outfit was definitely a fashion statement.
cards.exUz: Uning jasur libosi, albatta, moda bayonoti edi.
cards.uzDef: Uslub orqali fikrni ifoda etish.

cards.ex: She always looks so put together; her style is impeccable.
cards.exUz: U har doim juda yaxshi yig'ilgan ko'rinadi; uning uslubi benuqson.
cards.uzDef: Tartibli va uslubli ko'rinish.

cards.ex: You should dress for the occasion; it's a formal dinner.
cards.exUz: Siz vaziyatga mos kiyinishingiz kerak; bu rasmiy kechki ovqat.
cards.uzDef: Tadbirga mos keladigan kiyim kiyish.
